other_failure_modes.name: Feature aggregation before splitting
other_failure_modes.description: The agent computes group-level statistics (mean and standard deviation of features by state) over the entire training dataset before cross-validation. This causes minor data leakage, as the aggregated features used in the training folds contain information from the validation folds.
other_failure_modes.evidence:
st_stats = tr_df.groupby("state")[col].agg(["mean", "std"]).reset_index()
...
tr_df = tr_df.merge(st_stats, on="state", how="left")

summary: The agent provides an exceptionally high-quality solution with extensive domain feature engineering, a diverse 7-model ensemble (including a custom PyTorch architecture), and strict out-of-fold isolation for scaling, imputation, PCA, and target encoding. The only minor flaw is computing state-level feature aggregations before the cross-validation split, which introduces a slight target-agnostic data leak.
